note: Annual base salaries for the roles in each town supervisor's office, 2026, from each town's own records. Riverhead's figures are in authorized-2026.json, from the January 6, 2026 agenda packet. Each peer figure is quoted from the source text kept in etl/data/salary/peers/ (Smithtown's from a hand transcription of a scanned page, kept with the page image) and checked by scripts/verify-supervisor-office-pay.mjs. Salaries only: benefits, longevity and stipends for other duties are noted where the source gives them.

source.title: Brookhaven Town Board Organizational Meeting, January 5, 2026: Resolution 2026-51, Establishment of Salary Schedule for Town Employees (Office of the Supervisor, PDF page 352)

roles.title: Supervisor
roles.note: Elected. The schedule marks it “Pursuant to Public Hearing 11/20/25”. Brookhaven’s 2027 budget pays it from two lines, $141,893 and $35,473 in its 2026 adopted column (pages 29 and 43), which add to the same figure.

roles.title: Deputy Town Supervisor
roles.note: Marked “+ Stipend”: paid to a Town Board member who also serves as Deputy Supervisor (2027 budget, page 31), so not a full-time salary.

roles.title: Director of Finance
roles.note: In the Supervisor’s office, so the closest match to Riverhead’s budget officer. The schedule also titles the post Chief of Operations.

roles.title: Secretary (To Supervisor)
roles.note: Plus $400 longevity, as the schedule lists it.

missing.why: The 2026 salary schedule names no chief of staff in the Supervisor’s office, though Brookhaven’s 2027 budget counts one Chief of Staff position (page 31). That budget page pairs the Executive Assistant title with the deputy post, “Deputy Chief of Staff (Executive Asst)”. The schedule’s one Executive Assistant in the office is listed as Director of Communications ($100,296, charged to A1230), so it is not shown here as a chief of staff. The office also has a Government Liaison Officer ($128,125).

notFound.why: Its 2026 adopted budget is a 90 MB file on a town website that refused this site's automated requests.
Its 2026 salaries are set in administrative salary plan schedules by level and step, attached to Board resolutions, rather than listed by title; they were not read.
Its 2026 adopted budget is posted on the town's website, which refused this site's automated requests.
Its January 5, 2026 resolutions appoint a deputy supervisor and a confidential secretary to be paid 'as per the 2026 budget' without stating amounts, and the budget was not found.
